title: feat(types,plugin-view,app-shell)!: retire NamedListView.densityMode; both relays read the density through the fold (objectui#7924)
body:
Fixes #7924
Clause-②: yes

Director ruling **A′** on objectui#7924 (comment `5856690997`, amending ruling A `5852199633`). Claim `5856715104`, seat `domain:spec#1`, session `session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW`. This PR is the card's last scope: bucket ① of ruling `5690906005` was split off as objectui#10758 and is not touched here.

## What changes

- **`NamedListView.densityMode` becomes `densityMode?: never`** (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, the `NamedListView` block). The tombstone docblock names top-level `rowHeight`, warns off `userActions.rowHeight` (the boolean toolbar toggle), and says stored views keep rendering through the fold.
- **Hop 1, the `renderListView` composition in `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s `ObjectView`.** The two rungs `rowHeight: activeView?.rowHeight` and `densityMode: activeView?.densityMode` become one rung that hands the active view to `normalizeListViewSchema` and relays the result's `rowHeight`.
- **Hop 2, the object-page relay in `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `ObjectView`** (the `fullSchema` literal). The two rungs `rowHeight: viewDef.rowHeight ?? listSchema.rowHeight` and `densityMode: viewDef.densityMode ?? listSchema.densityMode` become one rung: the view's `rowHeight` read through `normalizeListViewSchema`, falling back to `listSchema.rowHeight`. That is view over list, the same shape the relay's `userActions` rung already uses.
- **`allowExport` stays declared.** Its docblock now names both relays that carry it (plugin-view's composition and app-shell's relay), which was the omission the first dev report found.
- **`@object-ui/react` `useDensityMode` JSDoc `@example`** now reads `rowHeightToDensityMode(activeView?.rowHeight)` and persists `{ rowHeight: DENSITY_MODE_TO_ROW_HEIGHT[m] }` instead of `{ densityMode: m }`. Docblock only, no behaviour change.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/7924-density-mode-through-fold.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/plugin-view`, with the BREAKING banner, the third-party `renderListView` host note, and the ADR-0087 **D2** disposition line.

After this change, the fold is the only code in `packages/*/src` that reads `densityMode` by name (`const legacyDensity = s.densityMode;` and `delete next.densityMode;` in `normalizeListViewSchema`). The zod `ListViewSchema` legacy-alias declaration also still names it; this ruling leaves that alone (see Acceptance notes).

## Premise re-verified before the first edit

The ruling's own grep, run at BASE `bf14b6460`: `git grep -n densityMode bf14b6460 -- 'packages/*/src/**' ':!**/__tests__/**'` exits 0 with **34** hits. By class:

| class | hits |
| --- | --- |
| app-shell relay (the code line and 1 comment) | 2 |
| plugin-view composition (the code line and 1 comment) | 2 |
| the fold (`const legacyDensity = s.densityMode;`, `delete next.densityMode;`, 4 docblock lines) | 6 |
| label namespace (10 locale `toolbar.densityMode` entries, plugin-list's `grid.toolbar.densityMode` default, 3 `t()` calls) | 14 |
| plugin-list comment | 1 |
| `useDensityMode` JSDoc example | 2 |
| types (the member, 2 `objectql.ts` docblocks, the zod README, 1 `objectql.zod.ts` docblock, the zod `ListViewSchema` line) | 6 |
| the co-located app-shell relay census test, which the `__tests__` exclusion does not cover | 1 |

The only code reads are the two hops and the fold, so the stop condition did not fire. Outside `packages/*/src`, `git grep densityMode -- apps examples e2e content docs skills` (CHANGELOG excluded) exits 1 with no hits. The firing control on the same trees, `git grep -l listViews -- apps` and `git grep -l rowHeight -- content docs skills examples`, does return hits.

## Pins

- **`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`**, re-pointed with no assertion deleted:
  - `densityMode` moves from `BUCKET_LOCAL_ONLY_RETAINED` into `NAMED_LIST_VIEW_TOMBSTONES` (16 → 17), and the AST-derived tombstone assertion follows.
  - The type pin `_DensityModeRetained` is re-pointed, not deleted. It is renamed `_DensityModeTombstoned` and now asserts that the member's type is `undefined`, with a comment recording what it used to assert.
  - A new `@ts-expect-error` refusal, `_refusedDensityMode`, is added, together with `_acceptedDensityCanonical` (`rowHeight: 'compact'` accepted on a named view). `_acceptedRetained` drops `densityMode`.
  - The `densityMode is RETAINED` case becomes `densityMode is RETIRED by ruling A′`. It asserts that the by-name line is absent at both relays, that the fold-through line is present at both (the firing control on the same files), and that the fold still names the key.
  - The bucket-③ intent case now also asserts that the tombstone text names top-level `rowHeight` and warns off `userActions.rowHeight`.
  - The named-view counter-control used to assert the literal text `rowHeight: activeView?.rowHeight,`. It now asserts the fold-through spelling off `activeView`. The claim it carries (`rowHeight` is read off `activeView`, not off a named view) is unchanged.
- **`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts`**: a new `densityMode` row, `{ kind: 'legacy-alias', canonical: 'rowHeight', mentions: 'normalizeListViewSchema' }`. Its evidence check requires the `rowHeight` rung to read the view AND to call `normalizeListViewSchema`. The `showDensity` row's reason no longer mentions a `densityMode` rung.
- **New: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.densityModeThroughFold-7924.test.tsx`**, the retirement pin for H1. It mounts the **real** plugin-view `ObjectView` under the real object page, stubs only `ListView` to capture its schema, and pins plugin-view on its own through a spy `renderListView`. The effective density is `normalizeListViewSchema(schema).rowHeight`, which is what `ListView` renders. The file has 8 cases: 4 per host (`SAME DENSITY` ×2, `THE CHANGE`, `CONTROL`).

## Reverse verification (both from the committed HEAD `dd43c757c`, every mutation through `ablation-replace.mjs` with its EXIT/INT/TERM restore, and every restore proven by blob hash equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`)

**1. The relays.** Both by-name hop lines were restored on top of HEAD, which is the BASE shape of the two hops. The anchors hit x1 → x0, and on-disk `grep -c` of each restored line read 1. **Predicted before the run:** exactly the two `THE CHANGE` cases red, the census `declares nothing that IS relayed` and `legacy-alias` checks red, and the 7779 `densityMode is RETIRED` case and counter-control red, so 6 red in total. Every `SAME DENSITY` and `CONTROL` case stays green, because the fold inside `ListView` gives the same density on either shape.

**Measured:** `Tests 6 failed | 256 passed (262)`. The 6 failures were exactly the 6 predicted cases, by name. All 6 `SAME DENSITY` / `CONTROL` cases in the new file stayed green, and that is the H1 pin: a stored `densityMode: 'compact'` view yields the same effective `rowHeight` at both hosts as it did on BASE. Both restores were proven.

**2. The type face.**
- (a) Consumer probe. A new file in `@object-ui/app-shell` held a `NamedListView` literal carrying `densityMode: 'compact'`, and app-shell's `tsc --noEmit` ran against the rebuilt `@object-ui/types`. Result: `error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`. The probe was removed by a trap, and `git status` was clean afterwards.
- (b) Tombstone widened back to the old three-value union. **Predicted:** 3 errors. **Measured:** `_EveryTombstoneAdmitsOnlyAbsence` TS2344, `_DensityModeTombstoned` TS2344, and `_refusedDensityMode` TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error`). The restore was proven.

## Acceptance notes

- **H2 (not this ruling).** The zod `ListViewSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` still declares `densityMode` as its legacy-alias line, and `list-view-spec-parity.test.ts` still ledgers it as input-only. `NamedListView` has no zod mirror, so the tombstone is on the TypeScript face only. This PR leaves the zod line as ruled.
- **H3 held false, as the first report found.** `viewDef` (app-shell) and the plugin-view `views` element are `any`-indexed, so the tombstone forced neither hop at compile time. Both hops were moved by hand, and the text pins above hold them.
- **One precedence delta, confined to third-party `renderListView` hosts (read from source, not run).** On BASE, a host whose list schema carried its own `rowHeight` beat a view that spelled its density `densityMode`: the relay merged the two into one schema, and the fold's rule "canonical wins" picked the host's value. Hop 2 now folds the view first and then applies view over list, so the view's density wins. In the Console this cannot arise, because the host is plugin-view's composition and its `rowHeight` comes from the same active view. The effective-density pins above were measured on that path. The changeset also says that a third-party host reading `schema.densityMode` now receives `schema.rowHeight`.
- **The changeset from the earlier landing (`.changeset/7924-named-list-view-retire.md`, from PR objectui#10285, still pending release)** says `densityMode` stays declared. This PR's changeset says in its body that it supersedes that line. The older file is outside this claim's file surface and is left untouched; the seat may prefer to amend it before release.
- **`normalize-list-view.ts` needed no docblock change.** Its fold behaviour is unchanged.
- **Observation, not filed (承接者:无).** The fold tests `legacyDensity in DENSITY_MODE_TO_ROW_HEIGHT`, and `in` walks the prototype chain. Measured on the built `@object-ui/core`: `normalizeListViewSchema({ densityMode: 'toString' })` returns a `rowHeight` of type `function` and drops the key, while the control `'cozy'` stays unfolded. `rowHeightToDensityMode` fixed the same shape in the other direction with `hasOwnProperty`. No producer writes such a value, so no public door gives a wrong answer, and it is noted here rather than filed.
- **Concurrency.** objectui#10770 edits the `ObjectChartSchema` block of `objectql.ts`, a disjoint region. objectui#10758 will edit plugin-view's delegation, a different region of the same file. Whichever lands later merges `main`.
- **Spec Main Shape Gate: NOT MEASURED locally.** The reason: the touched member is objectui-own (`densityMode` is not spec-derived), and the gate needs a spec tarball built from objectstack `main`. CI runs it.
- **Commit trailers are model-free.** The local commit was amended once, before its first push, to drop a model name from `Co-Authored-By`. No pushed history was rewritten.
